home.inicio_welcome: Welcome to Markcus' personal manufactorum. Here, grey miniatures are purged of their lack of color and blessed with sacred pigments, Nuln Oil washes, and ritual dry brushing.
home.inicio_note: We don't paint toys. We forge veterans of the Long War.

home.sobre_text: I´m Markcus, a loyal servant of the Emperor. My purpose is to expand the Emperor's domains, through wargaming and miniature modeling. Warhammer and miniature painting are my hobby and passion. That's why I put my skills as a painter at the service of all of you who want to increase your collection, even if you're a veteran or a beginner. I can paint anything: Space Marines, Imperial Guard, Necrons, Orks, etc. I can also paint miniatures that aren't from Warhammer.
